sous_titre: Volume mondial des transactions au premier semestre, en milliards de dollars, 2024 à 2026

1er sem. 2024.texte: Global secondary market volume of $103 billion increased 51% from $68 billion in H1 2024.

1er sem. 2025.texte: surpassing the prior first-half record of $103 billion set in 2025

1er sem. 2026.texte: Global secondary volume reached $118 billion, a new first-half high representing 15% growth over the $103 billion record set in H1 2025.
